title: Nourishing Savory Portuguese Leek Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring leeks, mustard, and tempering chocolate, perfect for a chilly evening, this plant-based friendly dish is a twist on traditional Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced leeks and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the mustard and tempering chocolate until the chocolate is melted and well combined.
Add the vegetable broth, potatoes, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
